responsibility: Managed Agent integration identities and the bounded, language-neutral operation request and report contract exchanged by native Clients, the Server relay, and the node-local writer. Actual consumers are orchbee-agent-integration-writer, which executes the contract on a node; orchbee-workbench-protocol, which embeds the documents in the Workbench Agent integration direction; orchbee-server and orchbee-worker, which relay and run integration jobs; and orchbee with its local-client and workbench-client crates, which submit jobs and render their reports.
nonGoals: Executing inspections or mutations, changing provider configuration, owning threads, processes, cancellation, or deadlines, authorization, transport framing, rendering, or CLI grammar.
Defining Desktop's TypeScript integration writer, the Agent observation contract, or the provider registry itself.
